about.label: About Me
about.heading: The Creative Mind Behind the Code
about.body: I'm a Product Engineer & Designer based in Buenos Aires, Argentina, building AI-driven products. I combine design and development in a single profile, which means I can take a product from concept to polished interface without losing coherence along the way. I care deeply about the details: the right spacing, the right interaction, the right words. That's how I build digital products that feel as good as they work.

process.body: We go over the problem, the people it's for and what success looks like.

services.pricing: Every project is quoted after the first call, as a fixed price for a defined scope or as a monthly rate for ongoing work.

faq.q: Do you work with companies outside Argentina?
faq.a: Yes. I work remotely with clients in the US and Latin America, in English or Spanish, 1–2 hours from US Eastern Time.

faq.q: Can you do only the design, or only the development?
faq.a: Yes. Most clients want both, but I also take design-only or development-only projects.

faq.q: Can you take over an app built with AI tools?
faq.a: Yes. I review the code, fix what's fragile and prepare it for production: data, authentication, performance and deployment.
Write to me with a few lines about your project. I'll reply to set up a 30-minute call.
